bio: In this pleasant restaurant done out in a timeless, refined style, chef Marco Wahl injects quality, flavour and personality into seasonal dishes – this is where the Palatinate-born chef's experience in some prestigious establishments comes into play. You can dine à la carte or opt for the set menu. Tuesday to Thursday (except public holidays) they also offer a surprise menu with three to four courses. The fact that you feel in good hands here is also down to the very friendly service team under the management of Patrik Schwabe....
